events.title: Update Demo V0.7.3

New remote weapon: slingshot5. Introduce a new market price fluctuation mechanism6. The Chenghuang Temple has added a record book of births and deaths, which records the information of deceased characters7. New role: Zombie8. New chapter system9. New animal: Dog
